Awesome First Experience. Horrid Crash
Three days ago a buddy of mine hit me up and told me he had some Molly for cheap. 3g at 60 dollars. How could I say no? So I jumped on it. Tossed a half at another buddy, and had my way with the rest over a 24 hour period. Started with a Gram. Parachuted it with some toilet paper. Shot some water down and sat back to clear my mine. I was alone, my first mistake. My second mistake was taking 2.5g for my first time. But we will get to that.
About 30 minutes later in a call with my partner I started to feel... Lifted. I bent down to stretch and rub my eyes. Opening my eyes the colors in the room were vivid. Clear. The individual fur strands on my dogs coat caught my eye. So clear. I sat back in the chair. Taken aback at how hard and how fast parachuting MDMA took hold of me. Life was great. Nothing could have felt better. I went over to the kitchen and stuck my nose against the screen. *deep breath* Wow! A mile from the beach, the salt on the air. I had to go for a walk. So I did. But making sure I was safe from LEO's I put on some dark sunglasses (Around 4pm) and walked to the store for some chewing gum.
Man my jaw... It wouldnt stop twitching. Slightly annoying but, not annoyed. Felt like I should have been. A half mile walk later. Paranoia taking hold. I got to the store. Went in. Place was hopping. 40-50 people in this 1,000 sq/ft store. People looking at me. Why? A wave hit me while standing in line with a pack of Doublemint. Sweat pouring down over my forehead. Two guys look at me. Whisper. Clear as day I hear 'He's high. Go outside.' I heard it. How? One went outside the other stood by the door eyeing me. I got to the cashier. Same cashier that sees me every day. She smiled, nervous. Cashed me out. I walk by the guy standing by the door. He watches me leave. His friend is on the phone in the car. Paranoia stronger. I walked home. No incident. Locked my door and put the key away. Not leaving again.
Two hours in I felt sexual but not aroused. Soft but needy. I pulled out a silk pair of shorts. Dropped everything. Put them on. Wow. Amazing. Pacing around the house. These shorts are amazing! Best shorts ever, hands down.
3 Hours in I find myself with my buddy who did a half. Smoking a bowl. (Mistake number three, so I hear) He left. Nothing sexual thank GOD. Then I went to bed cuddled in my pillows on hour three. Lost myself in the feeling of the blankets. Sweat soaking my comforter. Curled up around it like it was going to somehow return the love. And it did. In the form of touch.
Hour 4: At this point I was feeling quite sexual. Needy and just outright randy. Ending the skype call with my friends I decided to go find a toy. Something that could maybe help with this.. Sexual urge. I found a DUKE Bad Dragon in the bedside drawer of my table. Needless to say, without being too lewd here, I spent the next 4 hours intimately in tune with my Duke dildo. Losing track of time, never stopping. All over the house. Staying inside, aware that I was a risk to anyone who came over at this point. I look up at the clock, 4 hours of sticking inanimate objects into my ass, I noticed I never got hard once. Just the feeling.
This point its been 8 hours, about what my dealer told me it would take before the effect started to fade, and sure enough it did. Losing sexual interest in everything and anything. Blank emotionally and exhausted. I decided I was going to pass out. More easily said than done, I found myself unable to find a comfortable position in the bed. So I laid down on the couch and passed out. Waking up 5 hours later or so, I got up, feeling normal. But as time wore on, I felt more blank and less interested in anything and anyone.
Day 2: When I realized that I was crashing I nearly panicked. No one told me that the down is ass strong as the up but opposite. Tears rimming my eyes for no apparent reason I decided to lay down on the couch where I passed out for 3 hours. Waking up. I felt normal again. But as time wore on yet again, afternoon on day 2, the depression got worse. The stress was unbearable and it was caused by nothing. Nothing in my mind caused me stress, I was just stressed. Back aches were starting to creep in on me. Body pain that I still have on day 3. Day 3, today. Bursting into hysterical crying. I had not had this much stress in years due to a relatively laid back stoner lifestyle. Still down, very depressed.
The severe crash seems to be because of the dose I took but either way, hard drugs are out. It was an experience to be sure, not one I regret. But definately a one time deal for me.
